segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the serum is gentle and does not sting or irritate, unlike other acids they have tried, though breakouts persist for one of them at a reduced rate.
segments.oily: One reviewer with dehydrated, oily-combination skin reports the serum reduces whiteheads without stripping the skin.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report fewer new spots or whiteheads and lighter, less irritated chronic acne marks over weeks; one reviewer says it does little to improve pre-existing black/whiteheads.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers describe reduced frequency and severity of breakouts, including cystic acne, with some reporting acne fully cleared or resolved overnight around their period; one still gets breakouts a few times a month though they clear faster.
concerns.redness: Reviewers note reduced post-blemish redness and less irritation around active pimples, with one specifically citing help with redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers highlight the absence of dryness, flaking, or irritation compared to other acne treatments they have used, including one who avoided benzoyl peroxide's drying effects for this reason.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports reduced oiliness and better skin balance overall; another notes it does not leave the face feeling greasy.

extraits.titre: The most gentle salicylic acid serum
extraits.texte: I used this serum nightly for 3 weeks, then began alternating nights with azelaic acid to help with dark spots. The serum was really gentle on my sensitive skin and didn't cause any stinging, which was a huge surprise because most acids do make my face react a little bit. I am still getting breakouts a few times a month but they seem to be clearing faster than before which is an improvement! The only thing I don't love about this serum is the smell‚ÄîI know it's fragrance free (which is great!) but because there isn't any added fragrance, it kind of smells like french fry oil? Not the best lol, but it dissipates fairly quickly.

extraits.titre: Smells like potato but keeps my skin clear
extraits.texte: This is a very lightweight gel serum. It has a strong potato scent, so I only used it at night. My acne lesions went away after using for about 1 month. My skin type is dehydrated, oily-combo and I think it didn't strip my skin. It really works on helping reduce the number of whiteheads I had on my forehead. However, I wished it didn't have such a strong wet potato smell.
